title: Open source release of [EMCAPSNet](https://openreview.net/pdf?id=HJWLfGWRb)
summary: Evaluating EMCAPSNet, our EM-routing capsule network release, as a viewpoint-robust vision backbone: reproducing the smallNORB results (1.8 test error, 1.3 with patching) and stress-testing capsule routing at larger scale for the graphs-retrieval portfolio's pose-sensitive matching problems.
